questions.prompt: How many total litres of milk are produced across dairy farms in New Zealand in a single year?
reasoning: New Zealand has approximately 5 million dairy cows.
Each dairy cow produces an average of about 4,200 litres of milk per year.
Multiplying 5 million cows by 4,200 litres gives about 21 billion litres in total.

questions.prompt: How many total individual keys are pressed across all ATM machines operating nationwide in Canada in a single year?
reasoning: There are roughly 60,000 automated teller machines across Canada.
Each machine processes an average of about 40 customer transactions per day, totalling around 15,000 transactions per year per machine.
A typical banking transaction on an ATM involves pressing about 10 numeric and functional keys.
Multiplying 60,000 machines by 15,000 transactions and 10 key presses yields 900 million key presses.

questions.prompt: How many total hours do all domestic pet cats kept in households across Germany spend grooming themselves collectively in a single year?
reasoning: There are approximately 15 million pet cats living in households across Germany.
An average cat spends about one hour per day grooming its fur.
Multiplying 15 million cats by 1 hour gives 15 million hours per day across the country.
Multiplying 15 million daily hours by 365 days results in roughly 5.475 billion hours per year.
